description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Champions of Fenris — THE GREAT WOLF WATCHES / Countercharge (WP-S2): (once per battle round, per unit) when you target an ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit with HEROIC INTERVENTION, that use is -1CP. Fixture sw11e_s2_wolves_active; setup privileges: the Orks' Charge phase (active player 2), the Gretchin (marked as having charged this turn) placed ~3" from Arjac Rockfist and the Grey Hunters, P1 at 1 CP. A real click ends the Orks' Charge phase: the 15.11 HEROIC INTERVENTION window opens for the Space Wolves — Arjac Rockfist's row reads 0 CP (Countercharge), the Grey Hunters' row 1 CP. A real click on Arjac's Leap to Defend: the stratagem is used for 0 CP (P1 stays at 1 CP), the Game Log names Countercharge and Arjac's unit is marked for this battle round.

steps.script:
var H = load("res://tests/helpers/cus11e_c5_scen.gd")
GameState.set_active_player(2)
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(9)
H.move_to("U_GRETCHIN_C", 37.0, 44.0)
GameState.state.units["U_GRETCHIN_C"].flags["charged_this_turn"] = true
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 1
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
return int(GameState.get_current_phase())

var d = tree.current_scene._phase_end_confirm
if d != null and d.visible:
	d.get_ok_button().pressed.emit()
return true

steps.comment: REAL click: Leap to Defend with Arjac Rockfist
clean log: no ERROR line in this session's debug log
